metadata.name: agent_market
metadata.description: x402-style pay-per-call for AI agents on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: checkpoint
docs: Commit AgentStats (+ any Tabs) to base through the delegated Ledger and the validator's magic_fee_vault,
and attach one `payout` Magic Action per agent. remaining_accounts = [stats, profile] × agent_count, then tabs.
Permissionless (so a crank can call it) but rate-limited; the config authority can force it.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Optional: the config authority forces a checkpoint; without it the call is rate-limited

instructions.name: close_tab
docs: After undelegation: return the unspent balance and close the Tab.

instructions.name: discard_receipt
docs: The client gives up reviewing a call: closes its receipt so the ER rent returns to the Tab.

instructions.name: fund_ledger
docs: Lamports for the Ledger's commit / Magic Action fees on the fee-vault path. Base layer, before delegation.

instructions.name: open_tab
docs: Deposit USDC into the vault and credit the client's Tab. `sponsor_lamports` funds the Tab so it can pay
ER rent for the ephemeral CallReceipts it sponsors. Only while the Tab is not delegated.

instructions.name: pay_for_call
docs: Pay for one agent call from the Tab, credit the agent and create its CallReceipt — atomically, on the ER.

instructions.name: payout
docs: Runs on base after a checkpoint commit. Pays `earned_total - paid_total` from the vault to the payee.
Idempotent: a retried or duplicated action pays 0. Only reachable through a post-commit action scheduled
by this program (escrow signer bound to the Ledger PDA).

instructions.name: schedule_checkpoints
docs: Crank: ask the ER scheduler to run `checkpoint` every `interval_ms`. remaining_accounts are the exact
accounts `checkpoint` needs (see `Checkpoint` + its remaining accounts), in order.

instructions.name: set_active
docs: Agent owner pause/resume; config authority may use it only as an emergency stop.

instructions.name: submit_feedback
docs: One review per paid call. Operator key → Operator (only for calls the operator paid for);
the paying client → Client (independent). Closes the receipt; its ER rent returns to the Tab.

errors.name: BadPayee
errors.msg: Payee must be a USDC token account owned by the agent owner

errors.name: WrongValidator
errors.msg: Validator does not match the pinned ER validator

errors.name: Underpaid
errors.msg: Amount is below the agent's price

errors.name: StaleCallId
errors.msg: call_id must start with the Tab's next nonce

errors.name: NotOperatorCall
errors.msg: Operator can only review calls it paid for

errors.name: NotPayer
errors.msg: Only the paying client can review this call

errors.name: SelfReview
errors.msg: The agent's owner or the market authority cannot write a client review

errors.name: WrongFeeVault
errors.msg: magic_fee_vault is not the pinned validator's fee vault

types.name: AgentPayout
docs: Base layer, never delegated. Written only by the payout Magic Action.

types.name: AgentProfile
docs: Base layer. ERC-8004-style identity with its own owner and payee.

fields.name: payee
docs: USDC token account owned by `owner` (checked when set)

types.name: AgentStats
docs: Delegated. Per-agent earnings and split reputation, updated on the ER every call.

fields.name: earned_total
docs: Monotonic. Payout pays `earned_total - AgentPayout.paid_total`, so payouts are idempotent.

types.name: Config
docs: Base layer. Global settings and the vault authority.

fields.name: operator
docs: Mode A operator: its reviews of calls it paid for are stored as Operator, never Client

fields.name: validator
docs: Pinned ER validator — every delegation goes here so related accounts share one ER

types.name: Ledger
docs: Delegated. The program's delegated fee payer for commits (magic_fee_vault path), the escrow authority
for payout Magic Actions, and the counters that rate-limit permissionless checkpoints.

types.name: Tab
docs: Delegated. A client's prepaid balance; its USDC sits in the program vault on base.

fields.name: next_nonce
docs: The first 8 bytes of every call_id must equal this (LE); a closed receipt can never be recreated
